title: Theoretical study of ANTO molecular systems: Causes of insensitivity of the energetic compound NTO
abstract: AbstractThe ANTO molecular system, which comprises the energetic compound 3‐nitro‐1,2,4‐triazole‐5‐one (NTO, with its two lowest‐energy conformers L1 and L2), ammonia (NH3), and water (H2O) molecules, is introduced for a theoretical survey of corresponding geometrical structure and localized bonding character. With the medium (or solvent) of H2O and NH3, three intermolecular hydrogen bonds formed in the NTO + NH3 + H2O system would lower the overall molecular energy and stabilize. © 2004 Wiley Periodicals, Inc. Int J Quantum Chem, 2005
